questions.q: On the book cover 'All Change for the Chans!' (Booster A), what happens to eight-year-old Eric Chan during a storm?
questions.answer: He swaps bodies with his 35-year-old dad, Tony.
options: He turns into a funny dog.
He swaps bodies with his 35-year-old dad, Tony.
questions.explain: 根據 Booster A（p.25），八歲的 Eric 在暴風雨中與 35 歲的爸爸交換了身體，Eric 要去上班，爸爸卻要去返學。

questions.q: In Booster A, the 'Crown Readers' series is for Primary 4–6 students. Who is the illustrator of the front cover?
questions.explain: 根據 Booster A（p.25），作者是 Michael Hill，而封面插畫師（illustrator）是 Glenda Li。

questions.q: In the notice about after-school classes with 'Clive the Clown' (Booster B), Maggie Lau is in Class 2C. On which day can she have lessons?
questions.explain: 根據 Booster B（p.27–28），小一至小三（Primary 1–3）的課堂在星期一（Mondays 3–4 p.m.），Maggie 讀 2C 班，所以星期一上課。

questions.q: In Booster B, what is Clive the Clown's job?
questions.answer: To make people happy with jokes, magic tricks, juggling and balloon toys.
options: To make people happy with jokes, magic tricks, juggling and balloon toys.
To look after sick children as a doctor.
questions.explain: 根據 Booster B 第 2 題，Clive 是小丑，他的工作是表演魔術、雜耍和扭氣球逗人開心（make people happy）。

questions.q: In Booster C ('Bedtime Stories for Children' contents page), Anne reads: 'Oh dear! She dropped her purse again!' Which story is she reading?
options: Honest Ollie and the Maths Test
questions.explain: 根據 Booster C（p.29–30），經常粗心掉錢包（dropped her purse again）對應故事《Careless Cathy》。

questions.q: In Booster C, Paul reads: 'He could see the test papers on the teacher's desk...' Which story starting on page 35 is he reading?
questions.answer: Honest Ollie and the Maths Test
options: Honest Ollie and the Maths Test
The Day Grandpa Looked After Us
Why Don't You Play With Me?
Poor Charlie and the Chocolate Mountain
questions.explain: 看到老師桌上的測驗卷（test papers），對應第 35 頁開始的故事《Honest Ollie and the Maths Test》（因此在第 37 頁）。

questions.q: In Booster A, 'Book Shop Monthly' is the publisher of the book 'All Change for the Chans!'.
questions.explain: Book Shop Monthly 只是撰寫書評的雜誌（Tom Smith, Book Shop Monthly），並非出版社。
